title: Investigate whether a restricted cardpool speeds up golden tests
description: The golden prompt integration tests (make test-golden) compile the full XMage project and start a server, which loads all card sets. Most of the compilation and startup time may come from the ~40k card implementations in Mage.Sets. Since golden tests only use a handful of specific cards (e.g. Lightning Bolt, Memnite, Clone, basic lands), investigate whether restricting the cardpool — e.g. compiling only a subset of Mage.Sets, or configuring the server to load fewer sets — would meaningfully reduce the compile+startup time. This matters for CI where golden tests run on every PR.
